title: Door and portal read at the glance
where: north face, door at x=6, y=2..4, z=3 (inside gallery bay x5..7)
instruction: The spruce door sits in a spruce frame on dark planks and barely shows. Add surround(g,{at:[6,2,3],face:'north',width:1,height:2,preset:'timber',door:true}) in build.mjs's detail pass, and a carved lintel of dark_oak_stairs (top half) over x5..7 at y=4/5; keep the sign at (6,5,2).

title: Dragon heads: real carved shape
instruction: Replace dragon() in build.mjs with a 3-block curl: neck up/out in dark_oak_stairs (alternate top/bottom), jaw as an open dark_oak_trapdoor, a spruce_button for the eye, and two small spruce_stairs horns attached (not orphaned). Compare closeups with `mcd zoom --at 6,19,2`.

title: Gable-end timber saltire
where: front gable wall z=3 (x4..8,y13..16) and back gable z=13
instruction: Add stripped_spruce_log diagonal bracing / an X of spruce stairs on the dark planks gable triangle plus a carved centre post; one block proud of the wall plane.

title: Gallery railing lattice
where: all four gallery sides at y=2, between posts
instruction: Under each fence rail add open spruce_trapdoors on the gallery side (facing inward, open) so the railing reads as lattice; skip the x=6 front gap.

title: Lattice windows with shutters
where: nave sides x=3 and x=9 at z=5,8,11, y=3..4; front x=4,8
instruction: Run `mcd paint` or glazing(g,{preset:'grid'}) on the existing 1x2 panes; add open dark_oak_trapdoor shutters either side (facing outward) and a timber surround.

title: Spire cross finial
instruction: The lightning rod is the only finial. Within the 22-block cap swap the top 2 blocks for a small iron_bars cross (one vertical, two horizontal arms) or shorten the spire by one course to fit a cross.

title: Weather the stone base
instruction: `mcd paint` / weather moderate on the plinth: moss and cracked stone bricks lower course; add stone_brick_wall coping on the step flanks.

title: Hang more lanterns on the gallery
where: gallery posts x=1,11 at z=1,15 and mid-sides
instruction: Chain + hanging lantern at (x,5,z±1) inside each corner bay (same pattern as the door lanterns at (5,5,2),(7,5,2)); anchor to the eave course at y=7.

title: Roof tone: dark oak bands vs walls
instruction: palette flags roof-tone: change eave/ridge/verge in roof.json from dark_oak to spruce or mangrove for the verge/eave rows and re-run `mcd roof --spec roof.json --dry-run` first; keep the slate mix.

title: Side-gable relief on the top tier
where: top tier sides, x=3/x=9 faces y=12..16
instruction: The side of the top roof is a flat slate slab with a wood border (left/right elevation). Add dormers via roof.json dormers:{face:'west'|'east',count:2,style:'gable'} and re-run the dry-run.
